title: proofroom change statement (and seed statement)
description: One Finish's decisions on one change, signed once by a reviewer's passkey. See docs/approval-format.md for where it is stored and how the gate reads it.

type.description: change-approval: the reviewer saw a capture of the change itself. seed-approval: the reviewer saw a capture of a default branch commit (a seed). A reader refuses any other type.

repository.description: The repository's id: github:<numeric repository id> on GitHub, else the config's repositoryId.

baselines.description: The baselines directory the entries' paths are relative to.

change.description: The change the decisions are for, as the code host names it: pr:3486, mr:212, branch:feat/x.

capturedHead.description: The commit whose capture the reviewer saw: the change's own head for a change-approval, the default branch commit for a seed-approval.

previous.description: The id of this change's previous statement, null for the first, or the ids of every end of a fork this statement closes.

approvedAt.description: When the reviewer finished, in UTC. Informational: order is the previous chain's.

approval.description: The WebAuthn assertion over the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field.

hash.description: A file's SHA-256: the PNG's from its Git LFS pointer, or the bytes of any other file. Null: the file is absent.

path.description: A file inside the baselines directory, relative to it, not under reviews/.
